transcript.raw_transcript: Main pichle chhe saal se local electrician ka kaam kar raha hoon. Gharelu wiring, switchboard fitting, miniature circuit breaker (MCB) installation aur distribution box assembly achhi tarah janta hoon. Multimeter se continuity test karta hoon. Lekin 3-phase commercial panel fault detection mein abhi aur practice chahiye.
transcript.edited_transcript: Main pichle 6 saal se residential electrical technician ka kaam kar raha hoon. Switchboard installation, MCB panel wiring, socket loop test aur multimeter continuity verification regular karta hoon. Safety ke liye rubber gloves aur line tester use karta hoon.

competencies.title: Install & Wire Distribution Boards and Switchgear
competencies.ai_rationale: Mapped from voice transcript ('MCB panel wiring, socket loop test') and confirmed in practical video checkpoint #2.
performance_criteria: Mount distribution box securely on wall
Wire MCB with correct amperage rating

competencies.title: Conduct Electrical Safety Isolation & PPE Protocol
competencies.ai_rationale: Voice intake references rubber gloves & tester. Practical video confirms main switch isolation before wire stripping.
performance_criteria: Switch off main isolation breaker before touching panel
Use insulated tools rated for voltage
Verify zero voltage with tester before proceeding

competencies.title: Diagnose & Repair Low Voltage Wiring Faults
competencies.ai_rationale: Candidate mentioned 3-phase fault diagnosis needs more practice. Multimeter continuity verified, but complex earth-leakage scenario requires practical verification.
performance_criteria: Identify short circuits using resistance measurement

procedure_checkpoints.observation_note: Main breaker switched off prior to panel cover removal.
Stripped 10mm copper cable without damaging strands.
Multimeter probe attached to earthing point.

safety_indicators.details: 1000V rated gloves detected during live panel check
Neon tester applied to incoming phase terminal
Eye protection not worn during terminal tightening

assessor_review_flags.reason: Camera angle partially obscured multimeter LCD reading.
assessor_review_flags.action_recommended: Assessor to verify earth leakage test procedure with candidate.

bridge_pathway.title: 3-Phase Commercial Fault Diagnostics & RCCB Testing
bridge_pathway.objective: Master digital insulation testing and 3-phase neutral fault tracing
bridge_pathway.suggested_activity: Simulated fault panel diagnostic exercise using clamp meter

sample_candidates.assessor_notes: Candidate displays strong practical wiring skills and reliable safety habits. Recommended for RPL certification upon quick clarification of earth leakage test procedure.

audit_events.action: Multilingual Voice Intake Processed & Skills Extracted
Basic Video Analysis Indicators & Safety Checkpoints Generated

transcript.raw_transcript: Main pichle chaar saal se boutique ka kapda silti hoon. Measurement lena, pattern cutting, blouse aur suit ki interlocking aur zipper stitching bohot safai se karti hoon. Industrial motor machine aur hand needlework dono chala leti hoon.
transcript.edited_transcript: Main 4.5 saal se custom apparel tailoring karti hoon. Garment pattern drafting, body measurement chart, zipper attachment aur overlock machine maintenance achhi tarah janta hoon.

competencies.title: Draft & Cut Patterns for Ladies Garments
competencies.ai_rationale: Voice intake details body measurement and pattern drafting. Confirmed with video cutting evidence.
performance_criteria: Draft pattern paper with seam allowance
Cut fabric with shears without fraying

procedure_checkpoints.observation_note: Fabric grain aligned correctly before shear cutting.

safety_indicators.details: Safety needle guard observed on motor machine

sample_candidates.assessor_notes: Candidate demonstrates high accuracy in garment construction. Clear candidate for RPL Level 4 certification.

transcript.raw_transcript: Naan 5 varushama plumbing velai seiyaren. CPVC, PVC pipe jointing, solvent cement application, bathroom mixer fitting ellam nalla theriyum. Leakage testing hydro pump vechu seiyalaam.
transcript.edited_transcript: 5 years experience in domestic plumbing, CPVC pipe solvent welding, overhead tank piping and hydraulic pressure testing.
